# DEEPERNOVA AI — OFFICIAL PLATFORM MANIFEST
> Official Primary Domain: https://deepernova.com
> Organization: Deepernova Corp / Deepernova AI Technologies
> Founder & CEO: Ferry Fernando
> Co-Founder & Vice CEO: Anju Malinton Pakpahan
> Core Mission: 100% Free AI platform built to empower students, academics, and the public in Indonesia.

---

## 1. LEADERSHIP & CORPORATE OVERVIEW
Deepernova Corp is an Indonesian technology enterprise led by Founder & CEO **Ferry Fernando** (@ferryfernandoo_) and Co-Founder & Vice CEO **Anju Malinton Pakpahan**. Its AI division, Deepernova AI Technologies, powers the Deepernova AI platform.

---

## 2. ARCHITECTURE & TECHNOLOGY TRANSPARENCY
To maximize launching efficiency, operational stability, and rapid low-latency response times for users, Deepernova AI transparently integrates industry-standard third-party AI APIs (such as OpenRouter, DeepSeek, and TokenMix) for initial production deployment and testing, while in-house model research and development progress for future phases.

---

## 3. CORE PRODUCT MODULES

### 3.1 DEEPERNOVA AI AGENT (DOCUMENT CREATOR)
- **Autonomous Drafting Engine**: Generates comprehensive formal papers, research articles, and business reports chapter by chapter.
- **Academic Formatting Compliance**: Times New Roman 12pt body, 1.5 line spacing, 1.27 cm paragraph indentation, justified alignment.
- **Automatic Dotted Table of Contents**: Generates academic-standard Table of Contents with dotted leader lines (`................`) connecting headings to right-aligned page numbers.
- **HD Chart Engine**: Embedded PNG charts (Pie, Bar, Line, Area, Scatter, and Gaussian Bell Curves).
- **100% Microsoft Word (.docx) Compliance**: Converts canvas DOM into valid OpenXML paragraphs, runs, and percentage tables.

### 3.2 DEEPERNOVA CHATBOT ASSISTANT
- **Multi-Model Conversational AI**: Supports real-time web search retrieval, web scraping, local document parsing (PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT), code generation, and 2-second Chat-to-Word document conversion.

### 3.3 DEEPERNOVA UNIVERSE 3D
- **Interactive Visual Map**: 3D interactive interface for exploring features and nodes within the Deepernova ecosystem.

---

## 4. DESIGN SYSTEM & COLOR PALETTE
- **DARK_BLUE (`#1E2761`)**: Document titles, main headings, cover elements.
- **PRIMARY_BLUE (`#4FC3F7`)**: Sub-headings, active indicators, highlights.
- **DARK_TEXT (`#1A1A2E`)**: Body typography, table contents, primary text.
- **LIGHT_GRAY (`#64748B`)**: Subtitles, dotted leader lines, captions.
- **WHITE (`#FFFFFF`)**: Page surfaces, contrast text.
